name: La Trobe University
description:
La Trobe University is a public research university based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. A young institution with a lot of ambition, the university attracts over 7,000 overseas students from 110 different countries annually.

Students can choose from nine different campus locations to find their perfect home away from home. From the world-class molecular science complex to its very own wildlife sanctuary, students can enjoy a rich and varied life at La Trobe University.

What is the La Trobe University acceptance rate for International Students?

The La Trobe University acceptance rate is 100%.

According to the official QS World University Rankings 2017, research carried out at the university is ranked among the top 1.4% in the world. Therefore, research facilities at the university are varied, and research focuses on five priority areas linked to the United Nationâ€™s Sustainable Development Goals.

The university boasts an impressive law school for students to prepare for a long career in the law field. Sports facilities range from basketball courts to swimming pools, so students can easily stay active and enjoy leisurely pursuits.

While specific facilities vary depending on the campus, La Trobe University is unanimous for offering fully equipped classrooms, a particular team for international students, and placement opportunities that provide valuable work experience. Numerous libraries are accessible for all students across each campus, with a huge selection of books and other digital and print resources available. The Melbourne campus has a health clinic that offers a range of services from womenâ€™s healthcare to mental health services.

Student Life

The La Trobe Student Association has run the student magazine since 1967, providing a long tradition of amplifying the young voices of today. Numerous societies and over 20 sports clubs are registered with the student association, so students have a vibrant campus to enjoy with new friends that share their interests. From live gigs to visual art exhibitions, the campus frequently bursts with activities for students to enjoy in their downtime. Students can access counseling services and public lectures from noted speakers to enhance their mental well-being and learning experience.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
La Trobe University offers a variety of accommodation options to cater to individual requirements. All new international students are eligible for a 20% discount on weekly rent when they sign a semester or academic year contract to live on campus. 

The types of accommodation available vary from residential colleges to apartments, all fully furnished and with access to amenities such as recreational areas, laundry facilities, communal kitchens and more. Homestay accommodation is a great option for international students because they can practice their English language skills with a local family and get to grips with authentic Australian culture. La Trobe University also has a database of rental properties for students who need help finding off-campus accommodation and want impartial advice.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!
